A mysterious object found in an ancient egyptian wall carving

An ancient Egyptian carving shows a figure carefully presenting a strange object in his hands. The unusual shape, raised details, and mysterious form make this scene especially intriguing. Was it a symbolic ritual object, a ceremonial item, or something with a meaning we don’t fully understand today?

Take a closer look at this fascinating ancient carving and decide what you think it represents?
